card.name: Digits and spaces before numbers
card.fires_on: Spaces, digits or parentheses just before or inside years, volume numbers and counts in citations and statistics. Also the word 'amily' in 'caregiver/family' in analgesic communication advice.

modes.label: Numbers in citations
modes.description: A space, bracket or digit inside a year, volume or count just before more digits.

modes.label: Caregiver/family
modes.description: The ending of 'family' after 'caregiver/f' in a sentence about communication during changing analgesic needs.
modes.example: the patient, and the caregiver/f<<amily>> during periods of changing analgesic requirements

card.plain: It fires on the spot just before a number's remaining digits in dates and citations, and on the ending of 'caregiver/family'.
